observations.content: Assistant extracted 5 new Drive zips into APTIS/mat/x/ with correct Vietnamese filenames; inventory includes 52 audio files (LISTENING 1 + LISTENING 2 sets), 7 Grammar PDFs (ĐỀ GRAMMAR APTIS 1-7), 4 Vocabulary PDFs, 4 Reading PDFs with keys, many .doc/.docx writing files, PDFs for speaking, plus Giải thích ngữ pháp Tiếng Anh.pdf (262MB).
pip3 exists but pip install of rarfile is blocked (PEP 668 externally managed); no bsdtar, no unrar/unrar source, so aptis writing.rar (105MB) could not be opened by assistant.
First .doc text extraction attempt failed: Python re.PatternError 'bad escape \u at position 22' because a \u escape was used inside a bytes regex pattern.
Fixed .doc extraction via decode utf-16le and cp1252 then regex printable runs; Useful phrases.doc yielded 153 runs of text.

Useful phrases.doc contains 'PHRASES IN FORMAL AND INFORMAL EMAILS' with phrases like 'Dear Sir/ Madam.' and 'To whom it may concern: (especially AmE)' - identified as frame-bank material for Day 1-2.

Aptis-practice-book_405d37004d9e6a046dc9bfae4321d5fe.pdf has 93 pages; confirmed official British Council practice book (www.britishcouncil.org/aptis) covering Grammar test format (25 questions, 12 min), Vocabulary (25 questions, 13 min, 4 task types: synonym/meaning-in-context/definition/collocation matching) and Reading test format.
Aptis_Short_guide_2020_A4_FINAL.docx.pdf is 13 pages (official 2020 short guide) at mat/x/TÀI LIỆU APTIS /TÀI LIỆU TỔNG HỢP/.

LINK YOUTUBE docx was actually at x/TÀI LIỆU APTIS /LINK YOUTUBE... (not in TÀI LIỆU TỔNG HỢP); contents included https://youtu.be/dCLng39G7Rg, https://youtu.be/WWOBuiIw8UY, englishexamninja.com/aptis reading task 1 trial, britishcouncil.cn/en/exams/aptis/test-prepare, and YouTube channel UC-THmHXAL3VZ9NhjZC_qwuQ.

Assistant wrote APTIS/inventory-tai-lieu.md (3444 bytes) organizing the entire material library by plan day with status flags (✅ readable / 🔊 user listens / ⛔ rar unopenable / 📄 rough .doc) and identifying duplicate files/zips in mat/ that can be discarded.

Assistant edited APTIS/ke-hoach-7-ngay.md: added reference to [[inventory-tai-lieu]] in the header, and changed Day 7 to include 'Aptis Practice Book 93tr' as mock source alongside TestReach official.

Assistant reported to user: 5 new zips extracted, 6 duplicate zips/files in mat/ identified, inventory at APTIS/inventory-tai-lieu.md, practice book + Useful phrases.doc (formal/informal email phrases) + LISTENING 2 (14 new audio) + 7 Grammar + 4 Vocabulary + 4 Reading as treasures; only remaining limitations are aptis writing.rar (105MB, needs user's local extraction) and 52 audio files user must listen to himself.
User stated: 'mình đã giải nén aptis writing rồi nhé' (user extracted aptis writing.rar themselves).
Assistant located the extraction at x/TÀI LIỆU APTIS /WRITING/aptis writing/ (created 17:23), containing 99 files / 111MB total (24 docx, 37 doc, 35 pdf) plus an Aptis Writing Overview.ppt.

Rar contents included real graded scripts with examiner feedback: Helen_writing_test_SK_Serian_B2_with_commentsrev.docx (B2 with comments), Norazira_writing_progress_test_2_feedback_rev.docx, Writing__sandy.docx, Writing_Test___Juana_P.doc, plus many Vietnamese-named student full-test samples (Nguyen Thi Thu Huong.docx, Nguyễn T.Việt Hà Full test 1.docx, etc.).

Rar also contained official guides aptis-candidate-guide-web.pdf, candidate_guide_-_for_web.pdf, how_to_use_the_online_writing_exams.pdf; register-demonstration pair Here_is_an_exaggerated_formal_letter.docx/pdf and Here_is_an_example_of_an_informal_message2.pdf; Vietnamese how-to PDFs cach-viet-thu-phan-nan and cach-dien-dat-loi-than-phien; FCE writing books (SB/TB PDFs); and stencil teaching PPTs.

Verified Helen_writing_test_SK_Serian_B2_with_commentsrev.docx is a 2-Part 40-minute writing test with a chat-room scenario ('Education for All' volunteer program with Nigel) and a cancellation-letter task; Stenciling for the formal email part 4 PPT has 5 slides teaching a formal-email method (vocabulary, greetings and exits, grammar inversions and conditionals).
